experiments.why: The new Expired sub-tab with two past-due open laybys out of order and one due today, checking the oldest-first sort and that the due-date day itself is not expired.
Past-due laybys that are terminal, undated or at another hub must all stay off the new Expired list, leaving the empty state.

source.quote: defaults to collect when the field is absent (legacy pulls)

obligations.statement: dispositionOf returns DISPOSITION.COLLECT for a pull with no disposition field, or with disposition undefined or null.

source.quote: only the exact return_to_stock value branches to the new path
falls back to collect for unknown/garbage values (fail safe)

obligations.statement: dispositionOf returns DISPOSITION.COLLECT for any disposition other than the exact 'return_to_stock', including 'Return_To_Stock', 'returnToStock' and 'garbage'.
dispositionOf(null) and dispositionOf(undefined) return DISPOSITION.COLLECT without throwing.

source.quote: Absent/non-numeric balance renders as a dash so the card

obligations.statement: formatLaybyMoney returns a dash, never 'RNaN', when the amount is absent or not numeric.
formatLaybyMoney formats an amount in cents as rands with a thousands separator and two decimals: 123400 becomes 'R1,234.00'.

source.quote: Coerce an epoch-ms number OR an ISO/date string to epoch ms.

obligations.statement: toMs returns epoch milliseconds for both input forms: toMs(1704067200000) is 1704067200000 and toMs('2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z') is 1704067200000.

source.quote: Coerce an epoch-ms number OR an ISO/date string to epoch ms. Returns NaN when

obligations.statement: toMs returns NaN, rather than throwing or returning some other number, for a value it cannot parse, such as 'not a date'.

source.quote: not (yet) an exception (we can't judge it).

obligations.statement: isLaybyException returns false for a layby that has no scan deadline, whatever its dispatch or scan state.

source.quote: A layby is an EXCEPTION when it was dispatched but never scanned in and its

obligations.statement: isLaybyException returns true for a layby that was dispatched, was never scanned in, and whose scan deadline is earlier than nowMs.

source.quote: Expired = past the layby due date (end of the dueDate day).

obligations.statement: isPullExpired returns false while nowMs is still within the local due-date day itself, e.g. dueDate '2025-03-10' checked at 18:00 local time on 10 March 2025.

source.quote: Normalise an invoice number for matching (trim + uppercase).

obligations.statement: normalizeInvoiceNo trims surrounding whitespace and uppercases the value: '  l-12345 ' becomes 'L-12345'.

source.quote: migrated old-POS invoice numbers may not be L-NNNNN, so we never reshape them.

obligations.statement: normalizeInvoiceNo never reshapes a value into the L-NNNNN form: an old-POS number such as 'inv778' comes back only trimmed and uppercased, as 'INV778'.

source.quote: QR payload is JSON {v:1, laybyId, invoiceNo}

obligations.statement: parseLaybyScan decodes a QR payload of the JSON form {v:1, laybyId, invoiceNo}, e.g. {"v":1,"laybyId":"abc","invoiceNo":"L-00042"}, into laybyId 'abc' and invoiceNo 'L-00042'.

source.quote: that JSON is treated as a typed invoice number.

obligations.statement: parseLaybyScan treats any value that is not the QR JSON, such as a hand-typed 'L-12345', as a typed invoice number carried in invoiceNo rather than failing.
